text: Statistical tables project economic growth alongside declining public debt through 2031. Real GDP growth moves from 2.6 percent in 2024 to 12.3 percent in 2025, while General government gross debt falls from 43.0 percent of GDP in 2022 to 25.9 percent in 2031. For Allied Irish Banks, Bank of Ireland, and Permanent TSB, the NPL ratio drops to 1.5 percent in 2025. Footnotes state Depository Corporations Survey data are preliminary and subject to revision, while 2024 structural balances exclude CIT receipts of 2.5 percent of GDP following a Court of Justice of the EU judgment.
